reply_text: Dana, the only seat figure I can find for the 2026 renewal is the one Ilse posted here on 2026-10-14: **261 seats**. I couldn't confirm it against a document. The signed 2026 Renewal Order Form (executed 2026-03-20, effective 2026-04-01, renewal date 2027-03-31) doesn't state a seat count. Amendment No. 3 (executed 2026-09-22, effective 2027-01-01) sets the subscribed seats at **230** from 2027-01-01, which doesn't match 261. Ilse may be able to confirm which figure should go on the tracker.
